name: JHD Advisor — Universal Website Scraper + Odoo AI Builder v2

parameters.formDescription: Enter any competitor or inspiration website URL. The AI will scrape it, analyze the design, and build a professional JHD Advisor page in Odoo automatically.

values.placeholder: e.g. Free 2-hour automation audit for new clients — this week only

values.option: No — save as draft for review

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ url: $json.sourceUrl, formats: ['markdown', 'links', 'extract'], extract: { prompt: 'Extract from this website: 1) Color palette (describe primary, secondary, accent, background colors with hex codes if visible), 2) Navigation menu items, 3) All page sections present (hero, features, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, etc.), 4) Hero headline text, 5) Subheadline or tagline, 6) CTA button labels, 7) Key value propositions or benefit statements, 8) Trust signals (client counts, ratings, certifications, awards), 9) Technologies or tools mentioned, 10) Overall design style description (dark/light, modern/corporate, etc.), 11) Any pricing plans or packages mentioned, 12) Testimonial quotes if any' }, onlyMainContent: false, waitFor: 2000, timeout: 45000 }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'best IT consulting AI automation agency website design portfolio award 2024 2025', limit: 4 }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc:'2.0', method:'call', id:1, params:{ service:'common', method:'authenticate', args:[$('Parse Input + Config').item.json.ODOO_DB, $('Parse Input + Config').item.json.ODOO_USER, $('Parse Input + Config').item.json.ODOO_PASS, {}] } }) }}
={{ $json.publishReq || JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc:'2.0', method:'call', id:4, params:{ service:'common', method:'version', args:[] } }) }}

parameters.jsCode:
const prev = $('Code: Build Publish Request').item.json; const duration = Math.round((Date.now() - (parseInt(prev.ts) || Date.now())) / 1000); const published = prev.shouldPublish ? 'PUBLISHED LIVE' : 'SAVED AS DRAFT'; const emailBody = `

✅ JHD Advisor Page Ready

${published} — Built in ${duration}s

Page Type${prev.pageType}
Inspiration URL${prev.sourceUrl}
Design Style${prev.styleOver}
HTML Size${(prev.htmlLength/1024).toFixed(1)} KB
Page ID${prev.pageId || 'N/A'}
View ID${prev.viewId || 'N/A'}
Status${published}
🌐 Preview Page ⚙️ Odoo Admin

🤖 Built by JHD Advisor AI Website Builder v2 | Powered by Firecrawl + Claude AI + Odoo

`; console.log('[Done] pageId=' + prev.pageId + ' viewId=' + prev.viewId + ' published=' + prev.shouldPublish + ' duration=' + duration + 's'); return [{ json: { ...prev, emailBody, emailSubject: '✅ JHD Advisor page ready — ' + prev.pageType + ' (' + published + ')', duration } }];
